family.description: Bacillithiol (BSH) functions as a general thiol reductant, analogous to glutathione, in a wide range of bacterial species. Bacilliredoxins reduce those proteins that are modified by disulfide bond formation with BSH (S-bacillithiolation) [[cite:PUB00100073]]. This entry represents BrxC from Bacillus subtilis (formerly known as YtxJ) and similar bacterial proteins related to BSH. BrxC is a monothiol bacilliredoxin responsible for the removal of BSH from oxidized cytosolic proteins. It can also debacillithiolate the mixed disulfide form of the bacilliredoxin BrxB [[cite:PUB00055031],[cite:PUB00100075]]. It has a similar fold to thioredoxin. The homologue in Deinococcus radiodurans, named AbxC, plays a role in the response to oxidative stress [[cite:PUB00100126]].
family.name: Monothiol bacilliredoxin BrxC
